pages.title: Auth Service Architecture
pages.content:
# Auth Service

Auth Service owns the organization's authentication contracts. It provides Auth API v1 at POST /v1/auth and Auth API v2 at POST /v2/auth.

## Current production contract

Auth API v1 is the current production contract. MCP Gateway and Argo Orchestrator consume Auth API v1. Version v2 is available for migration testing, but introducing v2 does not by itself deprecate v1.

## Ownership

The Identity Platform team owns Auth Service and both API versions. AUTH-301 introduced the v1 contract. AUTH-302 introduced the parallel v2 contract.

pages.title: Auth API v1 Contract
pages.content:
# Auth API v1

Provider: Auth Service
Endpoint: POST /v1/auth
Consumers: MCP Gateway, Argo Orchestrator

The endpoint accepts a client identifier and credential and returns an access token. Removing or changing POST /v1/auth is a breaking change for every current consumer. Consumers must not be considered migrated until their repository no longer calls /v1/auth.
